title: Baked Norwegian Feta Pasta
description: A simple, baked pasta dish with Norwegian feta and a blend of herbs, perfect as a comforting dinner option.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta according to the package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Crumbled the Norwegian feta cheese and add it to the skillet with the garlic. Cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Drain the cooked pasta and add it to the skillet with the feta mixture. Toss well to combine.
Transfer the pasta mixture to a baking dish and top with chopped parsley.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Bake in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
